about: A Python library that pulls recipes, ingredients and servings out of cooking websites.

prs.title: Yields like 4 dozen cookies keep the dozen
prs.broken: A recipe yield of 4 dozen cookies came back as 4 cookies, losing the dozen.
prs.changed: Dozen is now kept as the unit whenever it appears, as the documentation already promised.
prs.matters: Recipe apps that scale by servings are no longer twelve times off for cookies and muffins.
